checklist.text: Boards are free of checks and loose knots

steps.title: Select stock
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for every species in the design and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots.

checklist.text: Reference face is flat before planing

steps.title: Mill stock
steps.instruction: Joint one face and one edge, then plane every board to the same milled thickness.

steps.title: Rip Walnut strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Walnut strips (S1) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

checklist.text: Bevel leans the way the cross-section view shows for this strip

steps.title: Rip and bevel Hard maple strips
steps.instruction: Set the fence and tilt the blade from the setup values, then rip and bevel the Hard maple strips (S2) in one pass each.

checklist.text: Bevel leans the way the cross-section view shows for this strip

steps.title: Rip and bevel Walnut strips
steps.instruction: Set the fence and tilt the blade from the setup values, then rip and bevel the Walnut strips (S3) in one pass each.

steps.title: Rip Hard maple strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Hard maple strips (S4) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip Cherry strips
steps.instruction: Rip the Cherry strips (S5) at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

checklist.text: Write S1 on the Walnut strip
Write S2 on the Hard maple strip
Write S3 on the Walnut strip
Write S4 on the Hard maple strip
Write S5 on the Cherry strip

steps.title: Mark the strips
steps.instruction: Write each strip label on its reference face so the design order survives handling.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap

steps.title: Arrange and dry fit
steps.instruction: Lay the strips out in design order with reference faces up, then dry clamp to check the joints.

steps.title: Glue and clamp
steps.instruction: Spread glue on each joint, assemble the strips in order, and clamp evenly.

steps.title: Let the glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the work clamped until the glue has set.

steps.title: Flatten the panel
steps.instruction: Scrape off the squeeze-out and flatten both faces so the panel is one consistent thickness for crosscutting.

steps.title: Mark the reference triangle
steps.instruction: Draw a cabinetmaker's triangle across the panel face, apex pointing at the top edge, so the slices keep their order and orientation after crosscutting.

steps.title: Crosscut the slices
steps.instruction: Square the leading end, then crosscut every slice against the stop block with the triangle facing up.

steps.title: Letter the slices
steps.instruction: Write each slice letter on its triangle face, in the order the slices came off the panel.

checklist.text: Position 2: slice A, turned end for end
Position 5: slice G, turned end for end and flipped over
Position 7: slice E, turned end for end

steps.title: Turn and arrange the slices
steps.instruction: Turn every slice a quarter turn so the end grain faces up, then lay them out in the order below, applying each rotation and flip.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap

steps.title: Dry fit the slices
steps.instruction: Clamp the arranged slices dry and check the pattern and the joints.

steps.title: Glue and clamp the board
steps.instruction: Glue the slices in order and clamp against a flat reference.

steps.title: Let the glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the work clamped until the glue has set.

steps.title: Square the board
steps.instruction: Trim the ends and sides square to reach the finished length and width.

steps.title: Surface to thickness
steps.instruction: Flatten and smooth both faces down to the finished thickness.

steps.title: Finish the board
steps.instruction: Sand through the grits and apply food-safe finish.
